title: Postlia
description: Schedule and publish social posts to 7 networks from AI agents. Postlia API key (Pro) required.
summary: Schedule and publish social posts to 7 networks from AI agents. Postlia API key (Pro) required.
offersHint: Schedule and publish social posts to 7 networks from AI agents. Postlia API key (Pro) required. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://postlia.com/api/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Postlia API key, starts with plk_>

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer <your Postlia API key, starts with plk_>

toolsPreview.name: list_accounts
toolsPreview.description: List the connected social accounts on this Postlia workspace.

toolsPreview.name: create_post
toolsPreview.description: Create a post. Provide scheduledAt (ISO datetime) to schedule, queue=true for the next open queue slot, or neither to post within ~5 minutes. Media platforms (instagram, tiktok, pinterest, youtube) need mediaUrl/mediaUrls from upload_media; tiktok/pinterest/youtube also need their options object.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_post
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a scheduled post by id.

toolsPreview.name: upload_media
toolsPreview.description: Pull an image or video from a public https URL into Postlia storage. Returns the storage URL and media type, ready for create_post. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV, max 25 MB.

toolsPreview.name: get_post_receipt
toolsPreview.description: Delivery receipt for a post: per-platform outcome (published/failed/retrying/pending), platform post ids, and the platform's real error text. Use this to VERIFY a post actually went live instead of assuming. Accepts the id from create_post or from list_published_posts.

toolsPreview.name: list_published_posts
toolsPreview.description: Recent post history with per-post outcome status and any platform errors.

toolsPreview.name: get_posting_quota
toolsPreview.description: The posting quota that will actually be enforced: tier, posts used, limit and remaining. Check this before composing a batch instead of discovering the limit via errors.

toolsPreview.name: reschedule_post
toolsPreview.description: Move a pending scheduled post to a new future time (ISO datetime).

toolsPreview.name: update_post_content
toolsPreview.description: Rewrite a pending scheduled post's text. Platform character limits are enforced.

toolsPreview.name: list_drafts
toolsPreview.description: List saved drafts (not scheduled, cost no quota).

toolsPreview.name: create_draft
toolsPreview.description: Save a draft for later without spending posting quota.

toolsPreview.name: get_queue_info
toolsPreview.description: The posting schedule (timezone + weekly slots) and the next open queue slots, i.e. when a create_post with queue=true would actually publish.

toolsPreview.name: get_analytics_summary
toolsPreview.description: Post-outcome summary over the last N days: totals, published/partial/failed counts, per-platform volume, and recent platform errors.
